title: Control of Topological Objects via In-Situ Advanced Microscopy Techniques
content: The control of electronic states is an emerging research field aimed at exploring novel quantum phenomena in condensed matter physics. In particular, the creation and control of topological electronic states—such as polar vortices in ferroic materials, especially in artificially twisted systems; magnetic skyrmions in helimagnets; and skyrmionic bubbles in van der Waals magnets—are crucial for future applications in next-generation electronic devices [1-4].
